Shareholders,

NET trades at about $170 against $163.62 of onchain backing per NET, a premium of three percent, with the inverse bond bidding under it at $161.19. 

For the first time since genesis the price and the number behind it are the same.

From zero

NetNet opened on July 17 with $0. 87 days later, the Treasury holds $24.53M and the Sleeve holds ~$4M of Stock Tokens and positions. 

How we get paid

There is no team allocation of NET, no salary drawn from the Treasury, and no share of the tax. Management is paid through pTEAM, our pToken in the tradition of pOHM. It is an option to mint NET at a strike of one USDG, against a cap of 15 percent of circulating supply. Every term is immutable and disclosed in full on the Management Compensation page of our docs, under pTEAM options. Every exercise is logged as an event on the contract, and the figures below are read from those events.

What we did with it

We exercised 13,320 NET of pTEAM in 192 clips between July 24 and September

.@entropyio just teased something for tomorrow.

The pearl is shining 🦪

I dug into the API and found a few interesting things.

Tomorrow’s event is probably connected to a new io market, PRL, with 3x max leverage. The market was registered in the API on September 26.

But there are two more interesting discoveries.

SBE appeared in the system as early as September 5 but still hasn’t been listed. It likely refers to SB Energy, a company building power infrastructure and data centers for AI. SB Energy recently filed for an IPO under the ticker SBE, so this could become another pre-IPO market.

If that mapping is correct, SBE would be Entropy’s third io pre-IPO market after ANTH and OAI.

The third discovery is io:H100, which appeared on the website today. H100 looks like a market tracking the cost of renting NVIDIA H100 compute, measured in dollars per GPU-hour.

So PRL may not be the only new io market coming soon.

SBE and H100 are already in the system, and one of them could become E
